interpretation: Within the SIL3724A candidate map, 0 V P-channel gate-source supports off bias and +6.3 V N-channel gate-source supports on bias at rest. No drain current, RF waveform or switching timing is measured; steadiness was not supplied. The 6.3 V N-gate reading questions the model that U2 drives it from 4.5 V VDD, but does not prove U2 supply membership or a fault.
disputed_assignment: U2.B2/native5 and its local C7 supply branch are modeled on VDD. Do not move them to H_RF_VDD or merge rails from voltages alone.
next_action: B74 U2 lower-centre supply contact to C6 upper end; B75 same U2 contact to printed VDD test point. Resistance with battery/programmer disconnected. These discriminate the RF supply from regulated VDD.
